title: importlog
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, importdataid, importfileid, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, ownerid, owningbusinessunit, owningteam, owninguser.

additionalinfo.description: Additional information related to the error.

createdon.description: Date and time when the import log was created.

importlogid.description: Unique identifier of the import log.

linenumber.description: Original line number of the data used in this log.

logphasecode.description: Phase for which the log is recorded.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the import log was last modified.

sequencenumber.description: Sequence number of the error in this log.

statuscode.description: Reason for the status of the import log.

_createdby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the import log.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the importlog.

_importdataid_value.description: Unique identifier of the import data for this import log.

_importfileid_value.description: Unique identifier of the import file for this import log.

_modifiedby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who last modified the import log.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who last modified the importlog.

_ownerid_value.description: Unique identifier of the user or team who owns the import log.

_owningbusinessunit_value.description: Business unit that owns the import log.

_owningteam_value.description: Unique identifier of the team who owns the import log.

_owninguser_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who owns the import log.
